eqcaps

A vendor-neutral database of EQ constraint profiles: what an EQ engine, a hardware DSP or a software EQ, actually accepts.

The format is a draft. Data is published on the pre-freeze channel /next/; the inspector will live here.

  • next/index.json: every profile, with its device match
  • next/bundle.json: every live profile in one file
  • next/schema/profile.schema.json
  • Source, format and contributing

Data is CC0-1.0. Code is MIT.
